morphology.pattern_note: 按人名 Louis 的解释处理，规范书写须大写首字母。无马来语词缀；IPA 为常见英语读法，不代表所有姓名持有者的读法。is_root 仅表示此解释下不可作马来语词缀分析。

senses.zh_definition: 路易：男性名字 Louis，也见于由此形成的专名；仅凭输入词形无法确定具体指称。
senses.en_definition: Louis, a masculine given name occurring in personal names and other proper names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang dieja Louis; rujukan khususnya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处为有依据的专名解释，不能据此认定输入中的 louis 必定指某个人。pos=noun 表示专有名词，不表示普通名词。下列为专名组合示例，非经语料统计确认的高频搭配。未提供 DBP 官方释义。[Oxford：Louis](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/louis)

etymology.historical_story: Louis is a French personal name with Germanic, specifically Frankish, ancestry, combining elements associated with fame and a warrior. Its long association with French royal families helped make it internationally recognisable. Its historical components explain the name's origin; they are not a Malay definition or a description of its bearer. [Oxford University Press](https://blog.oup.com/2013/07/royal-baby-name-meaning-george-alexander-louis/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Louis 与“路易”及姓名首字母大写联系起来；遇到真人，按本人介绍的读音记忆。
